small_shift_facts.proof: T operations before the only right shift preserve low16 indistinguishability. A shift<=15 cannot bring b16 into bit0; the target bit0 flips on b16.

runtime_initial_amount_probe.proof: All other operations are T functions of the initial words and shift result. If two amounts>=32, both shift results are zero; the outputs have equal low16, contradicting eight distinct target low3 values.
runtime_initial_amount_probe.scope: Exactly one data-dependent SHR, its amount reads an initial word, and every other operation is MAD/arithmetic/bitwise/literal-SHL. A new first-operation amount and multiple downward shifts remain open.

rectangle.proof: Every integer polynomial in the ten coordinates has mixed difference zero modulo 2^32; all coordinate increments are divisible by 2^16.

residual_images.proof: K*q or q*q has at most 65536 values when q is a literal SHR with count >=16.

inverse_fold_polynomial.scope: t is any one-MAD expression in the nine initial words; output t XOR (t>>s).

odd_product.proof: LSB transfer requires t odd. Then t*q nonzero and divisible by 2^16 is impossible for 0<=q<2^16: reduce modulo 2^16 and invert odd t.

permutation_sums.proof: A permutation of uint32 preserves the sum. t+K*q requires K even; t+q*q and t+t*q never preserve the sum.

two_mad.scope: MAD, SHR of its result, MAD; all nine inputs, all canonical operand roles and arbitrary constants. Same certificate holds for each count16..31.

two_shr.scope: Two initial-word literal right shifts then MAD. Consecutive shifts of one word are included by summing shift counts; amounts>=32 canonicalize to32.

scope: At most three straight-line MAD/XOR/AND/OR/literal-SHR operations, nine stated live inputs and arbitrary prepared root-dependent constants. ADD/SUB/MUL/literal-SHL normalize to MAD. Does not cover data-dependent shifts, division, comparison, FLOW or larger windows; no global kernel lower bound.
